headline: Legacy Law Offices acts on Dinotarp IPO

detail: Shakti Polytarp Limited, dba Dinotarp, has raised ₹26.93 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares consisting of a fresh issue of 45,64,000 shares. Legacy Law Offices advised Dinotarp as well as the Book Running Lead Manager Nexgen Financial Services Ltd on this SME IPO. The transaction team comprised of Naman Anand (Counsel) and Meghna Shukla (Associate). Surbhi Narang (Partner) provided strategic inputs.
